ai_model_architectures.fish_tracking: IoU track matcher (ByteTrack-style); behaviour metrics simulated from single frames
ai_model_architectures.water_telemetry: Water Quality Index from preset station values
ai_model_architectures.impact_fusion: XGBoost Regressor (160 estimators) trained on synthetic data
ai_model_architectures.biodiversity_loss: XGBoost Regressor (140 estimators) trained on synthetic data

data_provenance.plastic_detection: REAL - YOLO11-seg trained on TrashCan 1.0, run on real test images
data_provenance.plastic_detector_quality: Weak - trash_plastic precision ~0.37, recall ~0.31 on leak-free images (see HANDOFF.md)
data_provenance.fish_behavior: SIMULATED - fish boxes are real detections, but speed/turn values come from box size/position in a single image (no multi-frame tracking)
data_provenance.coral_health: HEURISTIC - colour/texture rule, not a trained model; TrashCan images are deep-sea ROV footage, mostly without coral
data_provenance.water_quality: SIMULATED - preset station values assigned to images in rotation, not measured for these images
data_provenance.impact_score_and_biodiversity_loss: SYNTHETIC TRAINING DATA - XGBoost learned a hand-written formula from generated data
data_provenance.shap: REAL - SHAP TreeExplainer on the XGBoost model (explains the model, which is trained on synthetic data)
data_provenance.saliency_heatmap: APPROXIMATE - blurred detection boxes, not gradient-based Grad-CAM
data_provenance.geospatial_map: SIMULATED - randomly generated stations around real reef regions
